has score anchor

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasScoreAnchor
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasScoreAnchor
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

Relates a criterion to one of its calibration anchors. NOT functional: high / medium / low anchors coexist.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Criterion -> gmeow:ScoreAnchor

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasScoreAnchor from gmeow:Criterion to gmeow:ScoreAnchor when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
